summary: Restore the established normal battle commitment order that was omitted from the shared battle definition during rules consolidation.

restoredRule.overridePolicy: A specific rule or effect may change commitment order or face state.

survivingEvidence: Watchtower requires the attacker to set their Gambit first, face up.
Fog of War changes which player sets their Gambit and chooses their Tactic after the opponent.
Neutral Observers explicitly overrides other Gambit-order effects and does not change Tactic order.
Intelligence Surveillance has timing after an opposing Gambit or Tactic choice.
classification: Restoration of existing intended behavior; not a new gameplay change.
